pr_comments:
> Nice investigation!
> 
> `TextEdit` changes the selection directly in `set_line` which probably causes this inconstancy in the first place, so we probably need to add another check there for `.selection.selecting_column`, otherwise might find this error occurring in a few other places.

I've moved the fix into `set_line` and removed the old one since it just seems redundant, Thank you.
@Lunarisnia Are you available to address latest feedback?

> @Lunarisnia Are you available to address latest feedback?

@YuriSizov  Sorry for letting this go stale, I have been quite busy these few weeks, I don't think I can address the feedback this week. Maybe I'll just close this so that people can take over?

@Lunarisnia There is no rush if you plan to eventually finish it! But voicing that others are welcome to take over is also fine. If anyone pick it up, we can always supersede your PR. In any case, no worries.

issue_context.title: Error when using `CTRL+/` on Windows
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.2.dev.custom_build [fba341ce4]

### System information

Godot v4.2.dev (fba341ce4) - Windows 10.0.19045 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 (NVIDIA; 30.0.15.1179) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 Threads)

### Issue description

When using `CTRL+/`, the console outputs an error.

### Steps to reproduce

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/74428638/ff4bd4c6-c5e3-4d6d-b6ce-08361839a42a

### Minimal reproduction project

N/A
comments:
I worked on this a little bit and here's what I figured out if anyone wants to help me with it:
 1. When the script line has 13 characters in it (ex.: `#extends Node`), [line 4983](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/a574c0296b38d5f786f249b12e6251e562c528cc/scene/gui/text_edit.cpp#L4983) sets the column to 13.
 2. When the same script line has 12 characters in it (ex.: `extends Node`), the `selecting_column` inside `carets.write[p_caret].selection.selecting_column` is still at column 13, it didn't get updated for some reason which means on the next call, it will fail in [line 4982](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/a574c0296b38d5f786f249b12e6251e562c528cc/scene/gui/text_edit.cpp#L4982) because the line has only 12 characters now.

 - Maybe a solution to this is to set the `selecting_column` when the user presses `CTRL+/` shortcut (I am not sure yet).
I can't reproduce this on 4.2.dev 42425baa5 (when using Toggle Comment while having the last character on the line selected, whether it's from the right or from the left).

@Calinou Did you completed the 6 steps?

1. Select the text with pointer
2. Use CTRL+/
3. Tap pointer's left button at the end of the line (as in video)
4. Repeat step 1
5. Repeat step 2
6. Repeat step 3. The error should show up here.

Note that it's not necessary to select the last character only, actually you can select multiple lines as well, just follow the steps exactly as in video.

Was able to replicate this on v4.2beta.
![2023-10-16T15:42:07,032716121+02:00](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/92468390/3b4a03ce-cbc7-4215-abdb-5caa39757b2e)

I did some of the investigation on my own and managed to replicate this on [a60fc7f](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/a60fc7f7c86daad48a8b23c9e4e1fe49cf3a0881). ![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/50898372/83ef7910-93d4-4477-a6d0-19a3cc56fc5f) I also found out that the issue can only be replicated by: 1. add a comment delimiter either manually or by using the shortcut 2. select the commented line starting from the last character to 1 or more character. 3. use the inline comment shortcut `CTRL+/`. 4. Left click on the last character on that line To help my explanation clearer lets imagine this example: ``` # Line below is 7 character long #var l1 ``` It seems like the issue came from the fact that pressing `CTRL+/` reduces the amount of character in a line without breaking the selection, Then when we click at the last character it still uses the old column count `(7)` because the `caret.write[x].selection.selecting_column` hasn't been updated yet. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/a574c0296b38d5f786f249b12e6251e562c528cc/scene/gui/text_edit.cpp#L1833-L1838 But then inside `TextEdit::set_selection_mode` on line `4978` it actually update the value on `caret.write[x].selection.selecting_column` to `6` causing line `4982` to actually compare past value `(7)` against newer value `(6 + 1)` which trigger the error message and `4983` is assigning an index that is out of bound. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/a574c0296b38d5f786f249b12e6251e562c528cc/scene/gui/text_edit.cpp#L4975-L4984 Updating `caret.write[x].selection.selecting_column` before calling `TextEdit::set_selection_mode` seem to fix it.

review_comments: Would add a new check for `selecting_column` as it's not guaranteed that `get_selection_to_line() == selecting_line`
